effects: Moves NFT `tokenId` of this collection from `from` (the signer, or an owner who approved the signer) to `to`.
Clears the single-token approval of `tokenId`.
No ETH or other token moves; the function is not payable.
formats.shown: Transfer token <artwork> from <from> to <to>, with From, To and Artwork fields.

effects: Moves NFT `tokenId` from `from` to `to` and calls onERC721Received on `to` when it is a contract.
Clears the single-token approval of `tokenId`.
formats.shown: Safely transfer token <artwork> to <to>, with From, To and Artwork fields.

findings.title: safeTransferFrom interpolatedIntent leaves out `from`, which matters when the signer moves a token as operator.
findings.evidence: descriptor safeTransferFrom(address,address,uint256): "interpolatedIntent": "Safely transfer token {tokenId} to {to}" while field `from` is shown; ERC721.safeTransferFrom accepts any `from` the caller is approved for (_isApprovedOrOwner).
findings.fix: Change interpolatedIntent to "Safely transfer token {tokenId} from {from} to {to}".

effects: Moves NFT `tokenId` from `from` to `to` and forwards `data` to onERC721Received on `to` when it is a contract.
Clears the single-token approval of `tokenId`.
formats.shown: Safely transfer token <artwork> to <to>, with From, To and Artwork fields; `data` is not shown.

findings.title: safeTransferFrom with data: interpolatedIntent leaves out `from`, though the signer can be an operator.
findings.evidence: descriptor: "interpolatedIntent": "Safely transfer token {tokenId} to {to}"; FeralfileExhibitionV3_2.safeTransferFrom(from,to,tokenId,data) -> ERC721.safeTransferFrom requires _isApprovedOrOwner(_msgSender(), tokenId), not msg.sender == from.
findings.fix: Change interpolatedIntent to "Safely transfer token {tokenId} from {from} to {to}".

findings.title: safeTransferFrom with data hides the callback `data`, which moves no signer asset.
findings.evidence: ERC721._safeTransfer: _checkOnERC721Received(from, to, tokenId, data); descriptor has no field for `data`.

effects: Sets `operator` as the single approved address that can transfer NFT `tokenId` of the signer (or of an owner whose operator the signer is).
Replaces any previous approval for that token; approving the zero address clears it.
formats.shown: Allow <operator> to transfer token <artwork>, with Operator and Artwork fields.

findings.title: approve shows the zero address as an operator to allow, but the code revokes the approval.
findings.evidence: ERC721._approve sets _tokenApprovals[tokenId] = to; IERC721 doc: "approving the zero address clears previous approvals". Descriptor: "interpolatedIntent": "Allow {operator} to transfer token {tokenId}", operator field has no special-value handling.
findings.fix: Add a sender/zero-address label for `operator`, for example a `$.metadata.constants` zero address shown as "None (revoke approval)".

effects: Grants (`approved` = true) or revokes (`approved` = false) `operator` control over every token of this collection that the signer owns, now and later.
formats.shown: "Set operator approval" and "true all tokens for <operator>", with Operator and a raw Approved field of true or false.

findings.title: setApprovalForAll shows the bool raw, so the sentence reads "true all tokens for X".
findings.evidence: descriptor: "interpolatedIntent": "{approved} all tokens for {operator}", field `approved` "format": "raw"; case 4 screen: "true all tokens for Test Operator", Approved "true". ERC721._setApprovalForAll(owner, operator, approved) grants or revokes full control.
findings.fix: Map `approved` with an enum {"0": "Revoke", "1": "Grant"} and change interpolatedIntent to "{approved} {operator} control of all your artworks".

findings.title: setApprovalForAll intent "Set operator approval" does not say it can give control of all the signer's artworks.
findings.evidence: descriptor: "intent": "Set operator approval"; ERC721.isApprovedForAll lets the operator call transferFrom/safeTransferFrom on every token the owner holds.
findings.fix: Change intent to "Grant or revoke access to all artworks".

effects: Permanently destroys each listed edition that the signer owns or is approved for.
Deletes the edition record and frees its IPFS CID; the signer loses the NFTs.
formats.shown: "Burn artwork editions" / "Permanently destroy selected editions", with each edition as an Artworks field.

findings.title: burnEditions interpolatedIntent does not name the editions that the signer destroys.
findings.evidence: descriptor: "interpolatedIntent": "Permanently destroy selected editions" while field `editionIDs_.[]` exists; burnEditions calls _burn(editionIDs_[i]) for each.

formats.key: authorizedTransfer((address from,address to,uint256 tokenID,uint256 expireTime,bytes32 r_,bytes32 s_,uint8 v_)[] transferParams_)
effects: Trustee or owner only: for each entry, moves NFT `tokenID` from `from` to `to`, using an off-chain signature by `from`.
Requires the signature to be unexpired at `expireTime`; the signer's own tokens move only when the signer is a `from`.
formats.shown: "Authorize artwork transfer" / "Execute authorized artwork transfers", with From, To, Artwork and expiry fields for each entry.

findings.title: authorizedTransfer intent says "Authorize", but the call executes transfers that owners already signed.
findings.evidence: descriptor: "intent": "Authorize artwork transfer" vs "interpolatedIntent": "Execute authorized artwork transfers"; _authorizedTransfer verifies isValidRequest(...) then calls _safeTransfer(from, to, tokenID, "").
findings.fix: Change intent to "Execute signed artwork transfers".

findings.title: authorizedTransfer shows from, to, token and expiry as separate lists that the signer cannot pair.
findings.evidence: descriptor fields: "transferParams_.[].from", "transferParams_.[].to", "transferParams_.[].tokenID", "transferParams_.[].expireTime" as four separate array fields.
findings.fix: Put the four fields in one field group with path "transferParams_.[]" so each entry renders together.

formats.key: createArtworks((string title,string artistName,string fingerprint,uint256 editionSize,uint256 AEAmount,uint256 PPAmount)[] artworks_)
effects: Trustee or owner only: registers each artwork with title, artist name, fingerprint and edition size.
Sets AEAmount and PPAmount, which raise the number of mintable editions to editionSize + AEAmount + PPAmount.
The artwork ID is derived from the fingerprint.
formats.shown: "Create artworks", with Title, Artist and Edition size fields; fingerprint, AEAmount and PPAmount are not shown.

findings.title: createArtworks hides AEAmount and PPAmount, which raise the mint cap above the edition size shown.
findings.evidence: _mintArtwork: require(editionNumber_ < artworks[artworkID_].editionSize + artworks[artworkID_].AEAmount + artworks[artworkID_].PPAmount); descriptor shows only `artworks_.[].editionSize` 'Edition size'.
findings.fix: Add fields for `artworks_.[].AEAmount` ("Artist editions") and `artworks_.[].PPAmount` ("Printer proofs").

findings.title: createArtworks shows title, artist and size as separate lists that the signer cannot pair.
findings.evidence: descriptor fields: "artworks_.[].title", "artworks_.[].artistName", "artworks_.[].editionSize" as separate array fields.
findings.fix: Put the fields in one field group with path "artworks_.[]".

formats.key: batchMint((uint256 artworkID,uint256 edition,address artist,address owner,string ipfsCID)[] mintParams_)
effects: Trustee or owner only: mints edition ID artworkID + edition to `artist`, then transfers it to `owner` when they differ.
Registers the edition's IPFS CID, which decides the token's metadata.
formats.shown: "Batch mint editions", with raw Artwork ID, raw Edition and Owner fields; artist and IPFS CID are not shown.

findings.title: batchMint hides `artist`, the first holder of each minted token, and the IPFS CID.
findings.evidence: _mintArtwork: _safeMint(artist_, editionID); if (artist_ != owner_) _safeTransfer(artist_, owner_, editionID, ""); registeredIPFSCIDs[ipfsCID_] = true. Descriptor fields: artworkID, edition, owner only.

findings.title: batchMint shows artwork ID, edition and owner as separate lists that the signer cannot pair.
findings.evidence: descriptor fields: "mintParams_.[].artworkID", "mintParams_.[].edition", "mintParams_.[].owner" as separate array fields.
findings.fix: Put the fields in one field group with path "mintParams_.[]".

effects: Trustee or owner only: sets the address that royaltyInfo returns as receiver for all secondary-sale royalties of the collection.
formats.shown: "Set royalty payout address", with the Payout address field.

findings.evidence: tokenURI: if (bytes(baseURI).length == 0) { baseURI = "ipfs://"; }; descriptor field `baseURI_` format raw.
